displayName: VB6 code-only modules → .NET 10 / minimal API + xUnit
description: Reference VB6→.NET-10 scaffold for headless VB6 sub-corpora: .bas standard modules, .cls service classes, scheduled batch jobs, COM components consumed by other code. Routines become minimal API endpoints (MapPost), IHostedService background workers, or library methods. DAO/ADO recordset walks become EF Core 10 queries (or Dapper for high-throughput batches); late-bound COM calls become explicit managed dependencies. Targets pure net10.0 — no Windows-specific bundle, deployable as Linux containers. Per ADR-036 this is the simplest of the three archetypes (no UI, no forms, no COM threading concerns) and ships second in 10.0.d's sequencing. Picked during Discovery for code-only sub-corpora the customer flagged as headless.

matches.fallback: Used whenever the spec's target_archetype_hint is 'MinimalApi', regardless of routine name. Code-only sub-corpora flagged during Discovery as headless route here.
